headline: Reopening of Anna Canteens
original_text: Revival of the Anna Canteen scheme to provide highly subsidized meals to the poor.
explainer: Anna Canteens offer breakfast, lunch, and dinner to the public at ₹5 per meal to ensure food security for daily wage workers and the poor.
status_reason: The scheme was relaunched on August 15, 2024, and has expanded to 269 operational canteens serving crores of meals.
